opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Lead applicant may include up to two Co-applicants covering different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research across the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities, in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust. Awards up to £200,000 for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation. Awards up to £8,000.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany in the humanities and social sciences. Seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens, EEA nationals, anyone with a UK doctorate, or those with strong prior association with the UK academic community. Must have completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards completion of a significant piece of publishable research.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas (quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities, languages) by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods through skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards of up to £10,000 for 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute holding an established role for the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status. Involvement of overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: Supports genuinely interdisciplinary international research projects led by UK-based humanities and social sciences researchers, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines. Awards up to £300,000 over 2 years.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy sectors. Up to two one-year fellowships of up to £150,000.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, in addition to the amount already requested for research expenses. Rolling deadline, reviewed monthly.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom. Applications require approval of the employing institution; independent scholars may apply.
opportunities.summary: The Academy's most popular scheme, providing awards up to £10,000 tenable for up to 24 months to cover the cost of expenses arising from a defined research project in the humanities and social sciences. Scheme opens 2 September 2026.
